techniques.name: Search Open Technical Databases
techniques.description: Adversaries may search publicly available research and technical documentation to learn how and where AI is used within a victim organization.

techniques.name: Acquire Infrastructure
techniques.description: Adversaries may buy, lease, or rent infrastructure for use throughout their operation against AI-enabled systems.

subtechniques.name: ML Development Workspaces
subtechniques.description: Adversaries may acquire access to ML development workspaces that provide the compute and data needed to build an attack.

mitigations.name: Limit Adversary Knowledge
mitigations.description: Limit the public release of technical information about the AI stack used in an organization's products or services.
